issues.claim: Section 2: "no chat, CRM or booking tool is present"
issues.problem: Overstated. What was verified is that no chat widget, CRM embed or booking script is loaded on the website. An adviser can run a CRM, phone system or scheduling tool off-site that would never appear in the page source, so the flat statement could be read (and rebutted by the owner) as a claim about his internal operations. analysis.json is correctly careful ("no chat widget, CRM embed or booking tool is loaded").
issues.fix: Reword to "no chat widget, CRM embed or booking tool is loaded on the site" and, if the point matters, add "we'd confirm what you use behind it".

issues.claim: Section 3: footer says he is an IAR of Koehler Asset Management, while the SEC/FINRA record updated 18 May 2026 "says he is not currently registered as one"
issues.problem: Each half is literally accurate on the sources I re-opened, but the juxtaposition implies a stronger finding than the record establishes. The IAPD report itself states that not all jurisdictions require IAR registration or may grant an exemption, and it lists no Koehler Asset Management relationship at all, so absence of a current IAR registration there does not by itself prove the footer is wrong. For a compliance-sensitive claim about a named adviser this needs the caveat, or it reads as an accusation.
issues.fix: Add one clause, e.g. "the record shows no current IAR registration and does not list Koehler Asset Management (IAPD notes some states do not require IAR registration, so this is worth confirming)", and keep the section framed as "check together" rather than as a finding.

issues.claim: "For the founder" note: the audit's figures are "the conservative pair"
issues.problem: True for opportunities 1 and 2 (audit ranges sit entirely below analysis.json's $1,400-$4,100 and $830-$2,200). Not true for opportunity 3: the audit gives $344-$688 while analysis.json gives $275-$1,100, so the audit's floor is higher than the analysis floor. analysis.json's own opportunity-3 range is also internally inconsistent (the $275 floor implies a 50% reduction at $22.95/hr, the $1,100 ceiling implies no reduction and no benefits load), so it should not be relied on for a comparison.
issues.fix: Replace with: "for opportunities 1 and 2 the audit's numbers are lower than the analysis ranges and are the ones to quote; for 3 the audit's ceiling is lower but its floor is higher because the analysis range is not built consistently - quote the audit's $344-$688."

issues.claim: Section 1 heading claim "advised retirees, families and business owners"
issues.problem: Not wrong, but assembled from two pages: the home page says "more than 40 years" and mentions retirement, selling a business and trusts/estates; the client categories come from the site's own sections (Retirees & Pre-Retirees, Individuals & Families, Strategic Business Planning). The Sources list only cites the home page for this line.
issues.fix: Optional: add https://www.politziner.com/about-njp or the section pages to the Sources so the client description is traceable to one click.
